title: Red Sun Sunflower - Plug Plants - 2x - Unusual Variety
description:
This is a rare and unique 6″ sunflower with vibrant red petals and chocolate colored seed center.  Grows 5-6 feet tall with multiple blossoms on individual branches.  Up to 10 flowers per plant!



 Plant after last frost in full sun, 18-24″ apart.



 Ready 90-100 days
